summary: Spine documents are the original Complaint (#1), the FAC (#32), the SAC (#170), the PI motion and reply (#46, #73), the PI ruling (#121), the MTD ruling on the FAC (#163), the OpenAI Answer & Counterclaim (#147 then #176), the order on the SAC and counterclaim MTD (#228), the MSJs (#327, #329), and Plaintiffs' MSJ opposition (#350). Below is the curated list with editorial notes; the broader docket includes 19 discovery letter briefs, 5 hearing transcripts, and 22 named declarants.

entries.label: Complaint
entries.title: Original Complaint with Jury Demand
entries.notes: Names Aestas Management Co., Aestas LLC, Altman, Brockman, and the OpenAI corporate web. 26 claims. Mooted by the FAC.

entries.label: Motion to Dismiss
entries.title: OpenAI defendants' MTD of original complaint
entries.notes: Withdrawn as moot after FAC filed.

entries.label: Amended Complaint
entries.title: Verified First Amended Complaint
entries.notes: Adds Shivon Zilis (derivatively) and xAI Corp. as plaintiffs. Founding-email exhibits attached at #32.1–#32.27.

entries.label: Exhibit 1
entries.title: May 25, 2015 Altman→Musk founding email
entries.notes: Source for the 'Manhattan Project for AI' framing.

entries.label: Exhibit 2
entries.title: Jun 24, 2015 founding-terms email; Musk reply 'Agree on all'
entries.notes: The closest thing to a written assent to the founding terms.

entries.label: Exhibit 3
entries.title: Nov 22, 2015 Brockman 'bootstrap' email
entries.notes: Plaintiffs' rhetorical anchor for the 'philanthropic hook' theory.

entries.label: Exhibit 10
entries.title: Sep 2016 Microsoft compute term-sheet thread
entries.notes: 'Microsoft's marketing bitch' email; goes to Musk's early skepticism.

entries.label: Exhibit 11
entries.title: Jul 20, 2017 Sutskever biweekly
entries.notes: Earliest documentary mention of 'Designing the for-profit structure'.

entries.label: Exhibit 13
entries.title: Sept 20–21, 2017 ultimatum + Sutskever/Brockman counter + Altman 'i remain enthusiastic about the non-profit structure!'
entries.notes: Single most cited exhibit on both sides.

entries.label: Exhibit 14
entries.title: Sept 22, 2017 Zilis→Musk status report
entries.notes: 'Great with keeping non-profit'.

entries.label: Motion for Preliminary Injunction
entries.title: Plaintiffs' Motion for Preliminary Injunction
entries.notes: Four enjoinment categories. The opportunity for the court's first substantive look at plaintiffs' theory.

entries.label: Opp. to PI
entries.title: Microsoft / Templeton / Hoffman opposition to PI
entries.notes: Includes the original Hoffman declaration (#65.21), later corrected at #287.

entries.label: Reply ISO PI
entries.title: Plaintiffs' reply ISO PI
entries.notes: Attaches declarations of Musk, Zilis, Birchall, Baker, Gracias.

entries.label: Amicus Motion
entries.title: Delaware AG amicus brief in support of PI
entries.notes: Filed by Kathleen Jennings, Delaware AG.

entries.label: Notice
entries.title: Notice of Filing of Declaration of Samuel Altman

entries.label: Transcript
entries.title: Transcript of Feb 4, 2025 PI hearing
entries.notes: Court reporter Raynee Mercado.

entries.label: Order
entries.title: Order Denying Motion for Preliminary Injunction
entries.notes: Signature judicial framing: charitable-trust theory 'a toss-up'; antitrust theory unsupported; offered an expedited fall-2025 trial.

entries.label: Answer & Counterclaim
entries.title: OpenAI Answer to FAC + Counterclaim against Musk and xAI
entries.notes: First counterclaim filing; harassment / sham-bid theory.

entries.label: Order
entries.title: Order on Motions to Dismiss FAC
entries.notes: The single most important pretrial ruling. Express contract dismissed w/o leave; implied contract, fraud, constructive fraud, charitable trust survive; Microsoft survives on tortious interference and aiding-and-abetting fiduciary duty; RICO §1962(c) granted leave; (a)(b) without leave; derivative claims dismissed.

entries.label: Amended Complaint
entries.title: Second Amended Complaint
entries.notes: Operative complaint. Drops Zilis as plaintiff; adds Aestas defendants back; re-pleads RICO and implied covenant.

entries.label: Order
entries.title: Order Granting in Part Motion to Strike
entries.notes: Strikes 16 of 55 affirmative defenses; pointed criticism of both sides' 'gamesmanship'.

entries.label: Order
entries.title: Order on plaintiffs' MTD of counterclaims; SAC screening
entries.notes: Counterclaims survive (UCL + tortious interference w/ prospective economic advantage). RICO and implied covenant on the SAC dismissed without leave. LOI litigation-privilege analysis at p.5–7.

entries.label: Order
entries.title: Pretrial schedule modification; relief from MSJ pre-filing conference
entries.notes: Sets the MSJ briefing window and trial date.

entries.label: Declaration
entries.title: Corrected Declaration of Reid Hoffman
entries.notes: Replaces the original Dec 2024 declaration.

entries.label: Motion for Summary Judgment
entries.title: OpenAI defendants' MSJ (public redacted)
entries.notes: Time-bar, no-fiduciary-relationship, settler-standing arguments. Significant redactions on equity figures.

entries.label: Motion for Summary Judgment
entries.title: Microsoft MSJ
entries.notes: Arm's-length partnership theory; capped-return structure described in detail.

entries.label: Declaration
entries.title: Declaration of Ilya Sutskever
entries.notes: Longest single declarant filing in the docket.

entries.label: Motion to Stay
entries.title: Sutskever motion to stay Discovery Order #324
entries.notes: Led to the Oct 31 order denying as moot at #348.

entries.label: Discovery Order
entries.title: Order denying Show-Cause; ordering Sutskever to comply

entries.label: Order
entries.title: Order denying motion for relief from non-dispositive pretrial order; denying motion to stay as moot

entries.label: MSJ Opposition
entries.title: Plaintiffs' opposition to OpenAI MSJ (public redacted)
entries.notes: Settler-standing under Restatement §94; statutory standing under Cal. Corp. Code §5142(a)(4); Bus. & Prof. Code §17510.8 fiduciary-duty theory.

entries.label: Order
entries.title: Order Re Trial Date — Jury Selection 4/27/2026; Jury Trial 4/28/2026
entries.notes: Cements the trial calendar after the MSJ hearing (Jan 7). Drives every downstream pretrial deadline.

entries.label: Order
entries.title: Order on Motion for Summary Judgment
entries.notes: The operative ruling defining what the jury hears. DENIES OpenAI defendants' MSJ in full — Counts IV (unjust enrichment), VI (constructive fraud), VII (fraud), and XVIII (breach of charitable trust) all SURVIVE. GRANTS Microsoft's MSJ as to Counts IV (unjust enrichment) and V (tortious interference); DENIES as to Count XIX (aiding and abetting fiduciary breach), which SURVIVES. Terminates Dkts. 327, 328, 329, 330, 351, 353, 356, 358, 360, 368, 373, 388. This order, not the MTD ruling at #163, is now the spine of the liability case.

entries.label: Daubert Motion
entries.title: Defendants' Motion to Exclude Opinions 3 Through 6 of Dr. C. Paul Wazzan
entries.notes: OpenAI's Daubert challenge to plaintiffs' damages expert. Denied at #452 (PTO #2) but Wazzan was later barred from the liability phase by PTO #4 (#477) — relevance only to remedies.

entries.label: Pretrial Conference Statement
entries.title: Joint Pretrial Conference Statement
entries.notes: Each side's statement of elements and evidence. Frames the disputed legal issues that PTO #3 (#456) then resolved.

entries.label: Exhibit List
entries.title: Plaintiffs' Exhibit List
entries.notes: Source of the 'PX-' exhibit numbering used throughout trial testimony.

entries.label: Exhibit List
entries.title: Joint Filing Regarding Disputed Discovery Designations

entries.label: Proposed Jury Instructions
entries.title: Proposed Jury Instructions
entries.notes: Both sides' competing instruction sets, plus jury-instruction conference rulings on Day 5 (May 1, 2026).

entries.label: Pretrial Order No. 1
entries.title: Pretrial Order No. 1
entries.notes: First of four numbered pretrial orders. Sets trial logistics and rulings on the bulk of pretrial motions.

entries.label: Pretrial Order No. 2
entries.title: Pretrial Order No. 2 Re: Motions in Limine and Daubert Motion
entries.notes: Resolves the 12 motions in limine (#402–#415) and OpenAI's Wazzan Daubert motion (#393, denied). Defines what evidence is in/out for trial.

entries.label: Pretrial Order No. 3
entries.title: Pretrial Order No. 3 Re: Disputed Legal Issues (Remedies; Statute of Limitations)
entries.notes: Two structural rulings: (1) disgorgement is an EQUITABLE remedy — judge decides the amount, not jury; (2) statute-of-limitations questions for the jury, but no continuing-violation instruction. The 'remedies = judge' holding is why plaintiffs' demand of up to $134B will be sized by Judge Gonzalez Rogers in the post-jury phase.

entries.label: Pretrial Order No. 4
entries.title: Pretrial Order No. 4 Re: Bifurcation and Outstanding Issues Raised in Dkt. No. 468
entries.notes: Bifurcates the trial into LIABILITY phase (Apr 28 – ~May 15) and REMEDIES phase (begins ~May 18). Allots 22 hours each to Musk and OpenAI defendants for liability, 5 hours to Microsoft. Excludes Wazzan from the liability phase (remedies-only relevance). Notes that if the jury finds Musk's action time-barred, the Court will likely accept that finding and direct verdict to defendants.

entries.label: Order
entries.title: Order Denying Emergency Motion to Intervene
entries.notes: Denies #457 motion to intervene filed by a third party shortly before trial.

entries.label: Minute Entry
entries.title: Jury Trial — Begun
entries.notes: Court reporter Irene Rodriguez. Day 2 first substantive testimony day after Apr 27 jury selection.

entries.label: Trial Brief
entries.title: Trial Brief (May 3, 2026)
entries.notes: Latest substantive filing in the docket as of this archive update.
